composition_variation: Paint an original 29-year-old anime woman with wavy dark brown hair and soft freckles, leaning comfortably beside a cafe window. Dress her in a fully opaque cream linen shirt buttoned neatly and loose rust-colored trousers. One hand holds a plain coffee cup at waist level. Use tactile watercolor, honey-colored sunlight, warm wooden frames, and sage shadows. Her bright direct gaze feels confident, friendly, and naturally stylish. Build an original peaceful portrait wallpaper, never a replica of existing artwork. Keep the upper 28% empty and quiet for the clock. Design at 1024x1536 for the central x158-866 crop, with the face inside x240-784. No text, logos, UI, weapons, violence, or extra characters.
